Medieval Dragon Attack

Piece Details

View larger artwork (new tab)

  • MediumOil paint on canvas
  • Year2021
  • CategoryOil painting
  • Notes16" x 20" on canvas

Overview

A chaotic scene of two fire-breathing dragons attacking civilization in a medieval setting. This was completely based on my imagination and gave me a good opportunity to challenge myself with coloring and shading a scene without much of a reference.

Process / Additional Notes

The concept evolved from numerous pencil sketches and grew into a real creation once it was laid out on canvas. I felt the colors come out while I painted this and became proud of it when it was completed.
